description: non_exhaustive was added to TrustAnchor at the same commit that added name_constraints. This is the correct timing. If added in a later release, any downstream exhaustive struct literal (TrustAnchor { subject: .., subject_public_key_info: .. }) valid before the attribute would break retroactively. Adding simultaneously means the struct has never been exhaustively constructable from outside the crate in any released version. A future contributor might suggest removing it to simplify test construction. That would give downstream code false confidence the field set is frozen and create a breaking change whenever a fourth field is added.
title: #[non_exhaustive] on TrustAnchor added with first new public field — correct timing, not belated
